role: The snow golem: built from a pumpkin on two snow blocks, throws snowballs at hostiles, melts in warm biomes, and leaves snow trails.
scope_reason: world.conf built_golems = off: player-built golems (snow golem and iron golem from a player build) are forced off in the oracle with a 'not supported yet' notice. Snow golems never spawn naturally in vanilla, so the switch removes the only entry point.
